title: Grifball web app
description: GrifballWebApp, one environment at a time: requests, outgoing calls, database, jobs, frontend and browsers, chats, runtime, logs and traces. Series pushed over OTLP.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: HTTP requests the backend served, per minute (health probes included).

panels.title: Server errors
panels.description: Share of backend requests answered 5xx.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile backend request time, health probes left out.

panels.title: Unhealthy checks
panels.description: Health checks that ended Degraded or Unhealthy in the last 10 minutes (e.g. halo_infinite: the Halo gateway).

panels.title: Live connections
panels.description: SignalR connections open now (the site's live updates).

panels.title: Exceptions
panels.description: Exceptions thrown in the backend, per minute (caught ones included).

panels.title: Requests by route
panels.description: Backend requests per minute, by route (top 10).

panels.title: Requests by status
panels.description: Backend requests per minute, by status code.

panels.title: p95 latency by route
panels.description: Slowest routes: 95th percentile request time (top 10), health probes left out.

panels.title: Server errors by route
panels.description: Backend 5xx answers per minute, by route.

panels.title: Outgoing HTTP by host
panels.description: Calls the backend makes, per minute, by host (the Halo gateway, Discord, Google, ...).

panels.title: Outgoing p95 by host
panels.description: 95th percentile time of those calls, by host.

panels.title: Outgoing errors by host
panels.description: Calls answered 4xx/5xx or failed, per minute, by host and status.

panels.title: Database operations by query
panels.description: Database operations per minute, by query summary (top 10).

panels.title: Slowest queries (p95)
panels.description: 95th percentile time of database operations, by query summary (top 10).

panels.title: EF Core
panels.description: Entity Framework queries and SaveChanges per minute, and failures: execution strategy (retried) and optimistic concurrency.

panels.title: Compiled query cache
panels.description: EF Core compiled query cache hit ratio: misses mean queries built each time.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(microsoft_entityframeworkcore_compiled_query_cache_hits_total{job=~"$namespace/.+"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / ((sum(rate(microsoft_entityframeworkcore_compiled_query_cache_hits_total{job=~"$namespace/.+"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(microsoft_entityframeworkcore_compiled_query_cache_misses_total{job=~"$namespace/.+"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)))

panels.title: Job runs by result
panels.description: Quartz job runs per hour, by job and result.

panels.title: Job run time (p95)
panels.description: 95th percentile time of a job run, by job.

panels.title: Jobs running
panels.description: Job runs in progress now, by job.

panels.title: Scheduler lock wait (p95)
panels.description: How long schedulers waited for the job store lock (several pods share it).

panels.title: Server rendering
panels.description: Pages the frontend rendered, per minute, by outcome (server: rendered there; browser: left to the browser; failed: left to the browser after failing), and the 95th percentile time of a server render (right).

panels.title: Frontend memory
panels.description: Resident memory of the frontend pods.

panels.title: Web vitals (p75)
panels.description: What visitors' browsers measured, 75th percentile: largest contentful paint, interaction to next paint, first contentful paint and time to first byte (through telemetry-gate).

panels.title: Layout shift (p75)
panels.description: Cumulative layout shift visitors' browsers measured, 75th percentile (under 0.1 is good).

panels.title: Model calls
panels.description: Calls the site chat and DMs make to their model, per hour, by provider and model.

panels.title: Tokens
panels.description: Tokens used per hour, by type (input, output) and model.

panels.title: Answer time (p95)
panels.description: How long a model call took in all (p95), and until its first streamed chunk (p95), by model.

panels.title: Model errors
panels.description: Model calls that failed, per hour, by error type.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Backend and worker CPU use, in cores, by pod.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Working set by pod.

panels.title: GC heap and pauses
panels.description: Managed heap after the last collection (left) and time paused for GC per minute (right).

panels.title: Thread pool queue
panels.description: Work items waiting for a thread pool thread: a lasting queue means starvation.

panels.title: Lock contention
panels.description: Monitor lock contentions per minute.

panels.title: Exceptions by type
panels.description: Exceptions thrown per minute, by type.

panels.title: Errors and warnings
panels.description: The backend's and the frontend's log lines at warning and above, as they send them over OTLP (Loki's detected_level, from their severity).

panels.title: Failed requests
panels.description: Traces with an error, newest first (Tempo). Open one to see where it failed.

panels.title: Slow requests
panels.description: Server spans that took over a second (Tempo).
